title_zh: A Conference Call in Real Life
title_en: A Conference Call in Real Life
videoTitle: A Conference Call in Real Life
textbookTitle_zh: 电话会议：谁进来了、谁掉线了、谁在静音
note_zh: 整段约 4 分钟。Tripp 和 Tyler 2014 年的真人短剧，演一通对不上的电话会议。英文按该视频的英文字幕整理；线路吵到听不清的几个词没有硬补。

sentences.speaker: System
sentences.en: Tripp Crosby has joined the meeting. Beth has joined the meeting.
sentences.zh: Tripp Crosby 加入了会议。Beth 加入了会议。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Hello? Tyler?
sentences.zh: 喂？Tyler？

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: No, this is Beth, from ICS.
sentences.zh: 不是，我是 ICS 的 Beth。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Oh, hey Beth. How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 哦，Beth。你怎么样？

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: Yeah, good. Making it, you know.
sentences.zh: 还行，对付着过。

sentences.speaker: System
sentences.en: Tyler has joined the meeting.
sentences.zh: Tyler 加入了会议。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: All right. This is Tripp. Who's here? Tyler's here. Beth's here. The purpose of today's meeting is to discuss the—
sentences.zh: 好。我是 Tripp。谁在？Tyler 在，Beth 在。今天会议的目的是讨论——
sentences.note: The purpose of today's meeting is to discuss… 电话会议报目的，经常被打断。

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: Yeah, I'll be able to do it in like thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 行，我大概三十分钟能做完。

sentences.speaker: System
sentences.en: John has joined the meeting.
sentences.zh: John 加入了会议。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Hi, John. I was just trying to go over the purpose of today's meeting, which is to discuss the delivery of—
sentences.zh: John 你好。我正在说今天的目的，是讨论交付——

sentences.speaker: System
sentences.en: Tyler has joined the meeting.
sentences.zh: Tyler 又加入了会议。

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: Sorry guys, I got cut off. Is Paul here? I sent him an invite.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我掉线了。Paul 在吗？我给他发了邀请。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Put in your access code.
sentences.zh: 输入你的接入码。

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: No, no, that's your PIN number. It should be a nine-digit number. Try pressing the pound key.
sentences.zh: 不，那是你的 PIN。应该是九位数。试着按一下井号键。

sentences.speaker: System
sentences.en: Paul has joined the meeting.
sentences.zh: Paul 加入了会议。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Any questions before we move on?
sentences.zh: 继续之前还有问题吗？
sentences.note: Any questions before we move on? 电话会议上往下翻页之前问一句。

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: Yes, this is Beth. What's our best plan of attack for the second quarter?
sentences.zh: 有，我是 Beth。第二季度我们最好的打法是什么？

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.en: I think what we should do is diversify, because—
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该把业务分散开，因为——

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: Well, it actually depends on how you look at it.
sentences.zh: 这其实要看你怎么看。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: That's a great graph, John. Tyler?
sentences.zh: 这张图很好，John。Tyler？

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: My main concern with the projections was that they're insufficient. They're not even taking into account the— did we lose Tyler again?
sentences.zh: 我主要担心那些预测不够。它们连……都没算进去。Tyler 又掉了吗？

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Hello? John, are you guys taking distributions?
sentences.zh: 喂？John，你们在做利润分配吗？

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.en: My bad. I was on mute. Let me start over. I've prepared a presentation. I'm sharing it with all of you. You should be able to see it on your screen right now.
sentences.zh: 我的错，我静音了。我重来。我准备了一份演示，正在共享。你们现在屏幕上应该能看到。
sentences.note: I was on mute. Let me start over. 电话会议上最常补的一句。

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: I don't see a link anywhere. It says I need to download a plug-in. We are all using Macs, I'm assuming?
sentences.zh: 我哪儿都看不到链接。它说要下一个插件。我们都是苹果电脑吧？

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Finances are looking great. Paul, do you have any comments on staffing?
sentences.zh: 财务看起来很好。Paul，人员方面你有什么意见？

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.en: I was thinking, if we get a few more contractor types in— hold on. Rex, get down!
sentences.zh: 我在想，如果我们再进几个外包——等等。Rex，下去！

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: I just want to go over a couple of details as we move into the next section. We've got three new departments coming on. By the end of Q3 I need detailed evaluations each month.
sentences.zh: 进入下一部分之前，我想过几个细节。有三个新部门要进来。到第三季度末，我需要你们每个月给详细评估。

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.en: Sorry guys, I'm driving through a dead spot.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我正开车经过没信号的地方。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: That's it. Beth, you'll send out a recap email. That could have taken the place of this whole meeting, correct?
sentences.zh: 就这样。Beth，你发一封复述邮件。这封邮件本来就能代替整场会，对吧？
sentences.note: send out a recap email：会后把决定写成邮件。

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.en: Yup. Always do.
sentences.zh: 对，我一直这么做。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Thanks for doing that, Beth. Dave, you've been here the whole time?
sentences.zh: 谢谢，Beth。Dave，你全程都在？

sentences.speaker: Dave
sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 在。

sentences.speaker: Tripp
sentences.en: Well, thanks everyone, once again.
sentences.zh: 那好，再次谢谢大家。
